feedback: Written before this candidate has raced. Evidence: the sensor row moved from y=0.04 to y=0.06 (iteration 2 to 3) lowered oval max_error from 0.0617 to 0.0598 and raised oval progress from 0.53 to 0.87, so forward sensing helps the oval. Widening the outer pair to x=±0.05 (iteration 4) cut oval progress to 0.80 and raised s-bend and slalom max_error, and 12 mm footprints (iteration 5) cut oval progress to 0.73, so both are rejected. Narrowing wheel_track to 0.085 (iteration 6) cut oval progress to 0.70 and did not move the bend exits. Across every geometry since iteration 2, s-bend and slalom max_error has stayed at 0.061 to 0.064. Softening the controller (iteration 4) moved oval oscillation only from 0.339 to 0.333, so damping alone is a weak lever. This candidate restores the iteration 3 geometry and controller exactly, so the next race is a clean baseline. If oval progress is at or above 0.85 and oval max_error stays near 0.06, the platform is stable and the remaining bend-exit gap is controller- or speed-limited, so geometry should stop changing. If oval steering_oscillation rises above 0.35 or the bend exits stay at 0.061 or above, the next change is controller damping, not geometry.
requested_changes: If the restored run holds oval progress at or above 0.85 and s-bend or slalom max_error stays at 0.061 or above: try sensor row y = 0.07 with x = ±0.04, sensor_size 0.016 and wheel_track 0.09 unchanged. Evidence: moving the row from y=0.04 to y=0.06 in iterations 2 to 3 lowered oval max_error from 0.0617 to 0.0598 and raised oval progress from 0.53 to 0.87.

Do not narrow wheel_track below 0.09 m or widen the outer pair beyond x = ±0.04 m. Evidence: wheel_track 0.085 (iteration 6) dropped oval progress from 0.87 to 0.70 with no bend-exit gain, and outer x = ±0.05 (iteration 4) dropped oval progress to 0.80.

If oval steering_oscillation stays above 0.3 after the restored run, keep the geometry and change the controller first (lower kp or raise kd in small steps). Evidence: iteration 4 showed that kp 2.0 with kd 0.35 moved oscillation only from 0.339 to 0.333, so the controller change needs to be larger or paired with a speed change.
